In this episode Brian and Anna Maria talk with colon therapist Suzanne Kruk about colon hydrotherapy at Hippocrates Wellness, describing the physical benefits of toning and hydrating the colon, the recommended treatment series, and immediate results people often experience.

They also explore the emotional and nervous-system aspects of colonics — how stored trauma can release during treatment, the shift to parasympathetic “rest and digest” mode, and practical tips for maintaining bowel health, especially when using medications that slow digestion.

Learn how Hippocrates Wellness in West Palm Beach provides colonics as part of a detox and healing program; for appointments call 561-471-8876 or visit HippocratesHealthInstitute.org.
